title: CppCon 2015: Sean Parent "Better Code: Data Structures"
summary: Sean Parent's CppCon 2015 talk on better use of standard containers and the goal of having no incidental data structures. It argues that proper containers can greatly simplify code.
why: Commenters say it changes how you think about types and the STL, and makes a case for simple modern C++.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: this one really made me aware of what just might be the best way to think about it.
